title: The Cloud and Fire Over the Tabernacle
description: On the day the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tent of the testimony. At night it looked like fire. Whenever the cloud lifted from over the tent, the Israelites broke camp; wherever the cloud settled, they made camp. By the Lord's command they broke camp, and by his command they made camp. Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for a day, several days, a month, or longer, they followed the Lord's instruction through Moses.
